boards.name: Paw Print
boards.introduces: Shelf play: tap a free cat onto the shelf; two matching cats break
boards.tip: Tap a free cat to send it to the shelf; two matching cats break!

boards.name: Fish
boards.introduces: Dimmed means blocked; the shelf lets you dig under a cat
boards.tip: Dimmed cats are blocked. Shelve the top cat to dig under it.

boards.name: Teacup
boards.introduces: Real puzzles start: which two copies you pair matters
boards.tip: Four of each cat. Which two you pair matters.

boards.name: Yarn Ball
boards.tip: Stuck? Hint shows a safe next cat.

boards.name: Lantern
boards.introduces: Undo spotlight; Daily unlocks after the win
boards.tip: Fill all 4 slots without a pair and the round ends. Revive sends them home.
